Credit Suisse Statue of Liberty (New Assay) is another version of precious Metals that is an investment option for many collectors and investors. These gram gold bars are made of 99.99% of pure gold which is considered a high-quality and fine product.

The design of 10 gram gold bar credit suisse is simple and elegant and is made of 25.3 x 15.2 mm dimensions which can be easily stored and transported. The observer side of this gold bar exhibits the weight, purity, and emblem, whereas, on the reverse side, 10 gram statue of liberty credit suisse gold bar depicts the patriotic design of the Statue of Liberty.

This product contains 10 grams (0.3215 troy oz) of .9999 fine gold.

The individual component of this product has been updated to a more secure TEP (Technical Execution Plan).
These products are Eligible for Precious Metals IRAs.
The 10 gram gold bar’s observer side features the credit suisse emblem, weight, and purity.
